findings.reason: The approved order-04 design specifies finite POVM/effects/instruments, but this theorem adds countable Kraus outcomes; `def-nrqm-composites-framework-composite-systems-and-local-readouts` §(e) and `pthm-nrqm-composites-local-instruments-and-no-signalling` consume this scope, so owner disposition is needed.

Clause (d) admits abstract instruments on arbitrary measurable outcome spaces, while the approved design and physical_scope limit outcomes to finite or countable sets; owner approval or scope delimitation is required.

Clause (d) defines effects through potentially countable subseries without specifying their convergence mode or the general-H effect order; define them by quadratic-form bounds and state that each subseries converges strongly.
Clause (d) invokes an abstract instrument by cross-reference but omits its operative conditions of complete positivity, trace-norm countable additivity, and trace preservation.
Clause (d) says the result depends only on the ray of $Pu$ without defining ray; state that it is the equivalence class under nonzero complex rescaling.

u(P_a\psi)$ without defining the normalization map or its domain; define $

e0$ or write the normalized vector directly.
Clauses (ii)–(iii) give conditional claims for the $+$ branch over $0\le\theta\le\pi$, but at $\theta=\pi$ that branch has probability zero; qualify the conditionals by positive branch probability.
Clause (i) assigns a conditional state after transmission for arbitrary $\alpha,\beta$, but when $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=0$ the branch has probability zero; qualify the conditional-state claim.
Clause (ii) assigns a conditional detected state for all $\alpha$, though $p_{\mathrm{det}}=p|\alpha|^2=0$ at $\alpha=0$; restrict the update to $\alpha\ne0$.
